November 24, 2026 16:05 ET


SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) —[Surrozen, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=IZ6gViif1SDD_naAmHtrVKb9EVtsci9--3CEkA4CsCNMYM99ZTZYIS8OCwXFxkCxHFs5hnFV1pWFOe5Zlr67z4bNZCCzYEnZk1rsmHONQZw=) (“Surrozen” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: SRZN), a biotechnology company pioneering targeted therapeutics to harness the power of Wnt signaling to address the underlying drivers of disease in sight-threatening ophthalmic conditions, today announced that Company management will present at an upcoming healthcare investor conference.


**Piper Sandler 38th Annual Healthcare Conference on Thursday, December 3, 2026**


Fireside Chat at 6:30 AM Pacific Time / 9:30 AM Eastern Time

**About Surrozen** ****


Surrozen is a biotechnology company, pioneering a new class of Wnt-based therapeutics designed to harness the power of Wnt signaling to treat sight-threatening ophthalmic conditions. Built on deep scientific expertise and a proprietary antibody-engineering platform, Surrozen develops multifunctional biologics that selectively activate Wnt signaling in combination with other key disease pathways. Our approach aims to deliver best-in-class, durable therapies that have the potential to transform patient outcomes in some of the most pressing unmet medical needs in ocular diseases. For more information, visit[www.surrozen.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=YJBTVXDkwGRVCFsRUaGZFjd44EgJ3R747Ukp20Amc_5XXNJaNgclk4NK3iUMc91NB3UbyUNdaqwGZ4wEwzGgSs0sgSQrgScfMNHJ2SZ5KbA=) .
